authority: spec/08_SEWCP-900_RF_Feedthrough_Bracket.md Rev A (FROZEN) - RS-D01..RS-D07, section 6 (OFHC C10100, formed R20, silver 8-13 um direct on copper per DR-7)

scope.bounded: The formed strap solid: 50.0 wide x 0.50 thick, developed 180.0, S-form compliance path R20 from the 8.0 feedthrough level up to the chuck terminal level. Terminal bolt holes 2x O6.6 at 25 centres in the chuck-end pad.
scope.modelling_conventions: DECISION (design agent, repaired at assembly integration): the strap is modelled in the INSTALLED form, in the Datum-A radial frame (x = radius at the 105 deg ray, z = height above Datum A). The free neutral-S of the previous issue placed the terminal pad at z=48 / r=148.2 where no land exists - the pad could not mate spec/01 CP-IF-8 (land on the CP BOTTOM face, z=20, r 128..146) and the loop swept the heater-plate band. Installed path: vertical feedthrough leg at x=15 (inside the OD60 aperture, FBA-5, clearing the SEWCP-800 tube), R20 90-deg bend, run at z=8.0 (RS-D04), two R20 arcs of 45.06938 deg (RS-D05) rising 11.75 to the pad mid-plane 19.75, pad flat 40.0 ending at the land outer radius 146.0; holes at r=137.0 on the CP tap radius, 9.0 from the end. Developed length closes RS-D03 = 180.0 exactly; the leg length 34.43821 absorbs the balance (feedthrough terminal is external scope and clamps along the leg). Only the chuck-end pad holes are modelled. Plating, edge radii and pad flatness remain process/drawing callouts.
scope.open_state: SEWCP-904 shroud envelope has no dimensional authority in spec/08 (material, grooves and assembly gaps only) - recorded as a requirement gap for the drawing stage; not invented here.

requirements.statement: 50.0 x 0.50 strip, developed 180.0, installed form: leg 34.43821 at x=15, R20 bend, run 42.6815 at z=8, two R20 arcs of 45.06938 deg rising to the 19.75 pad mid-plane, pad flat 40.0 to x=146 (land outer radius).

value.rationale: Installed S closing dev=180: 34.43821 + 31.41593 + 42.6815 + 2x15.73218 + 40.0; pad top face at Z=20.000 on the CP-IF-8 land.

requirements.statement: 2x O6.6 terminal bolt holes at 25 centres in the chuck-end pad, through the 0.5 strip, centred 9 mm from the strap end - at r=137.0, the CP-IF-8 tap radius. NOTE: the 25.0 pitch (RS-D07) does not close against the plate taps at 98.73/111.27 deg (chord 29.94) - raised as ECR-D-013, owner-reserved; the frozen RS-D07 value is kept until ruled.

drills.rationale: Pad hole 1; vertical through the flat pad - modelled as a short symmetric drill normal to the pad.

requirements.statement: Blank, deburr R0.5, single R20 mandrel form, anneal, pickle, silver 8-13 um DIRECTLY on copper (no nickel underplate - DR-7), flatten pads to 0.05 TIR, 4-wire <= 3 mOhm.

interfaces.nature: 2x M6 at 25 centres onto the plate's rf taps (98.73/111.27 - verified)
